question: Under Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana, the maximum premium payable by the farmers will be ___ for annual commercial crops.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Option 2 (0.05)**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• Under the Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY), farmers are required to pay a uniform premium of only 2% for Kharif crops and 1.5% for Rabi crops.
 
• The maximum premium payable by farmers for annual commercial and horticultural crops is 5%.
 
• The balance premium is equally shared by the Central and State Governments to ensure full insurance protection for farmers.
 
• PMFBY aims to provide comprehensive insurance coverage against crop failure, thus stabilizing farmers' income and encouraging them to adopt innovative practices.
 
• Launched in 2016, PMFBY is one of the largest crop insurance schemes globally in terms of farmer participation and the number of crops insured.
